name: Reception hours and directions
description: Term-time Monday–Friday 07:30–16:30 UTC. Lessons 08:15–15:15 UTC. Main gate entry; visitor parking and accessible entrance beside reception. Contact reception@willowbrook.example.invalid (demo address, not monitored).

name: Admissions office
description: Monday–Friday 08:00–16:00 UTC during term time. Contact admissions@willowbrook.example.invalid (demo address, not monitored). Staff review eligibility, documents and places.

name: School transport
description: Transport is optional and charged separately. Routes, eligibility and prices require confirmation by reception; none are guaranteed in this demo.

name: Safeguarding lead
description: Contact reception directly and ask for the safeguarding lead. For immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Chat requests are not emergency alerts.
